short_description: Global Time Echoes: 25-Year Analysis of CODE Precise Clock Products. Extended analysis of 165.2M measurements over 25.3 years confirms long-baseline recovery and reveals long-period geophysical coupling including 18.6-year nutation cycle.
long_description:
Analysis of 25.3 years of global GNSS timing data (165.2 million station-pair observations) documents persistent velocity-dependent correlations in atomic clock networks. The directional search recovers RA=6°, Dec=+4° near Earth's aphelion-velocity tangent; the CMB-apex template is anti-phase, so the result is reported as an annual orbital-phase direction rather than a CMB-rest-frame detection.

Website: https://mlsmawfield.com/tep/gnss-ii/
